lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paper, because the Enclave keeps one physical copy of everything it cannot afford to have edited.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My own personnel file is in here. Eleven years, four commendations, and a note from the fourth year saying I ask too many questions about counterparties.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The note is dated seven years before tonight. Somebody has been waiting a long time to be right about you.
